title: configure issue template
body:
I recommend to setup an issue template which contains some important information to the issue reporters like "write in english", "give a descriptive title", "provide version of xDrip", etc.

Good templates can be found at [Awesome GitHub Issues & PRs Templates](https://github.com/devspace/awesome-github-templates).

comments.body: A good [example](https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/new/choose) was posted by @psonnera at Gitter. The implementation can be found at https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/tree/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.
